instruct them about minimizing the waste and damage to the stone.

keep the team motivated to get the quality output

pcs.pc_description: Trace the product design on the piece of cardboard/fiber sheet.
Cut the cardboard/fiber sheet as per the design to create the product design framework and crosscheck it against the approved design.

modules.module_title: Inspect the stone and mark the product design on it

pcs.pc_description: Inspect the stone to determine the direction of the grain.
Place the cardboard / fiber sheet cut as per the product design on the stone in such a way that the grain is in line with the length of the design.
Fix the pattern of cardboard/fiber and then draw the design on the stone using the crayon.
Mark the design on all sides of the stone by taking care to maintain the height and width of the template on each side.
Remove the cardboard/fiber sheet from the stone.
Check that the design marks on the stone are clearly visible.
Ensure that the product design framework is accurate.
Ensure that product design is drawn on the stone in a way that enhances structural integrity.

modules.module_title: Applying stenciling method on stone surface

pcs.pc_description: Smooth and clean the stone for the stencil to sit properly.
Made stencil from paper, plastic, or metal.
Cut out the design from the material, leaving spaces where the pattern will be applied.
Place the stencil on the stone surface where the design to appear.
Use tape or weights to hold the stencil in place so it doesn’t move while doing work.
Use colour pencil or regular pencil to mark the design of the stencil.
Lift the stencil to reveal the pattern on the stone surface.
Use a tool to etch or carve the design into the stone.
